name: Kubfu
flavorText: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.
description: Kubfu is the Wushu Pokémon, a Fighting-type first discovered in the Galar region. It is an extremely rare Legendary Pokémon! It stands 2'00" (0.6 m) tall and weighs 26.5 lbs (12.0 kg). If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
